VERDICT: LGTM

The new `addSelfLink` method drops cleanly into the established pattern in `OwnerMapper`. This interface already hosts a dozen `@AfterMapping default void addXxx(Owner, @MappingTarget OwnerDto)` methods, each filling one presentation-only field with matching Javadoc; the new method mirrors that idiom exactly — including the null-guard convention already used by `addAgeBand` (`OwnerMapper.java:132`). It's placed logically at the end of the `@AfterMapping` block before `toOwner`, so nothing is duplicated and no single unit is turning into a catch-all — the mapper is precisely where derived DTO fields belong here. The `openapi.yml` addition sits alongside the other computed `readOnly` fields (`displayName`, etc.) with consistent formatting. A maintainer of this codebase would find this entirely natural.
